blocks.style: STYLE: clean modern illustrated isometric game art for a cozy office simulation game. Soft cel shading with gentle gradients, smooth crisp vector-like edges, slightly chunky rounded friendly proportions, muted warm pastel palette with soft whites, light oak wood, sage green and dusty blue accents. Soft key light from the upper left, subtle ambient occlusion in creases. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-render plastic look, no heavy black outlines. Original design, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
blocks.chroma: BACKGROUND: the entire background is one perfectly flat solid pure magenta color #FF00FF, edge to edge, no gradient, no texture, no floor plane, no ground shadow, no vignette, no frame. The subject is centered with generous empty margin on every side and is never cropped. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the subject itself.
blocks.char: CHARACTER STYLE: stylized cute-but-not-chibi proportions (head about 1/4.5 of body height), simple friendly face with dot eyes, clean readable silhouette, soft cel shading matching the furniture style.
blocks.adult: AGE: the character is clearly a grown-up ADULT office professional in their late twenties to thirties: adult face with a defined jaw and cheekbones, adult neck and shoulders, adult body proportions with longer legs. NOT a child, NOT a teenager, NOT a kid.
